# sk Documentation

A robots.txt-style index of the sk documentation set for LLMs: every public page grouped by audience, each with its title, path, and one-line summary.

## Concepts

- [Connectors & Integration](docs/concepts/connectors.md): Outcome: authenticate an external system once, reuse it across every workflow, and never let a secret touch a workflow definition, an AI prompt, or a log.
- [Concepts & Domain Model](docs/concepts/glossary.md): One vocabulary, defined once.
- [Governance & Audit](docs/concepts/governance-and-audit.md): Pass the audit on the first pass.
- [Knowledge & Skills](docs/concepts/knowledge-and-skills.md): Outcome: authoring grounded in your own conventions — not generic API docs — so workflows ship faster, with fewer rework cycles and fewer compliance surprises.
- [Architecture Overview](docs/concepts/overview.md): Ship audited automation in hours, not sprints — and keep every run compliant by construction.
- [Workflow Execution](docs/concepts/workflows.md): Approved workflows run the same way every time — deterministic, immutable, fully audited.

## Operators

- [Connectors & Credentials (operator guide)](docs/operators/connectors-and-credentials.md): Connect a system once, reuse it everywhere — and the credential is never exposed.
- [Notifications](docs/operators/notifications.md): Operators hear about what matters, not noise.
- [Observability & Resource Limits](docs/operators/observability.md): See every run, catch drift before it costs you.
- [Quickstart — Operator](docs/operators/quickstart.md): Outcome: a governed, audited automation engine your whole team can use — live in production in 15 minutes.
- [Scheduling & Hooks (operator guide)](docs/operators/scheduling-and-hooks.md): Outcome: automation that fires on time or on event — verified at the door.
- [Self-Healing in Operations](docs/operators/self-healing.md): Outcome: workflows survive upstream API changes without silent failure.

## Authors

- [AI-Assisted Authoring](docs/authors/authoring-workflows.md): Describe the outcome.
- [Custom Skills](docs/authors/custom-skills.md): Outcome: the system encodes your conventions once, then applies them on every Conversation, discovery, and repair — so authored workflows ship faster, pass review sooner, and stay policy-uniform across tenants.
- [Knowledge Sources](docs/authors/knowledge-sources.md): Outcome: workflows follow your runbooks and compliance docs, not generic knowledge.
- [Quickstart — Authors](docs/authors/quickstart.md): Turn a plain-language request into a governed, audited, runnable workflow — in about 5 minutes, no code.
- [Recipe authoring](docs/authors/recipes.md): Common automations start from a vetted blueprint, not a blank page.
- [Using the `sk` REPL — authoring by conversation](docs/authors/repl-tour.md): Go from idea to a governed, versioned workflow in minutes — no JSON, no glue code.
- [sk settings](docs/authors/settings.md): Settings for the sk CLI itself — separate from the engine's runtime settings (see settings-reference).
- [Slash commands](docs/authors/slash-commands.md): Slash commands run from the sk REPL.

## Developers

- [sk CLI reference](docs/developers/cli-reference.md): Non-interactive commands for the sk CLI.
- [Evidence process — verifying a behavioral / LLM-path change](docs/developers/evidence-process.md): Outcome: changes to LLM-driven paths ship proven, not guessed.
- [Input Surfaces](docs/developers/input-surfaces.md): Meet your team where they already work — without re-implementing access control per channel.
- [Quickstart — Developer](docs/developers/quickstart.md): Ship to sk with confidence: a green quality gate on every change keeps regressions out of production.
- [Quickstart — Zero to Running](docs/developers/self-host.md): sk runs inside your own infrastructure — your data stays yours.
- [Tool palette and dispatch](docs/developers/tool-palette.md): Outcome: every LLM action against sk is a named, governed tool — one registry, one policy gate, one audit trail.

## Admins

- [Configuring the engine](docs/admins/configuration.md): Outcome: one validated configuration, or the engine refuses to boot.
- [Credentials & Keys](docs/admins/credentials-and-keys.md): Every integration secret is encrypted at rest, rotated on demand, and never logged, returned in an API response, or shown to the AI.
- [Production hardening — known caveats & TODOs](docs/admins/production-hardening.md): Outcome: ship sk production-ready, audit-ready, and recoverable.
- [Admin Quickstart](docs/admins/quickstart.md): Every workflow run is permission-checked, scoped, and audited — so a team can move fast without losing the governance trail compliance needs.
- [RBAC & Roles](docs/admins/rbac-and-roles.md): Least-privilege by default, every decision auditable.
- [subkit runtime settings](docs/admins/settings-reference.md): Every value below lives in subkit.config.json and is editable via sk settings configure or sk settings set .
